statements.description: When a server transaction is constructed for a request, it enters the "Proceeding" state.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The state machine MUST enter the "Completed" state when the TU passes a response with status code from 300 to 699.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The purpose of the "Confirmed" state is to absorb any additional ACK messages that arrive, triggered from retransmissions of the final response.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Once the transaction is in the "Terminated" state, it MUST be destroyed immediately.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: When a server transaction is constructed for a request, it enters the "Proceeding" state. The server transaction MUST generate a 100 (Trying) response unless it knows that the TU will generate a provisional or final response within 200 ms. The request MUST be passed to the TU.
actions: send 100 Trying unless TU will generate provisional or final response within 200ms

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: So long as the server transaction is in the "Proceeding" state, each of these MUST be passed to the transport layer for transmission. They do not cause a change in the state of the server transaction.
actions: pass provisional response to transport layer for transmission

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If a request retransmission is received while in the "Proceeding" state, the most recent provisional response that was received from the TU MUST be passed to the transport layer for retransmission.
actions: pass most recent provisional response to transport layer for retransmission

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If, while in the "Proceeding" state, the TU passes a 2xx response to the server transaction, the server transaction MUST pass this response to the transport layer for transmission. The server transaction MUST then transition to the "Terminated" state.
actions: pass 2xx response to transport layer for transmission

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: While in the "Proceeding" state, if the TU passes a response with status code from 300 to 699 to the server transaction, the response MUST be passed to the transport layer for transmission, and the state machine MUST enter the "Completed" state. For unreliable transports, timer G is set to fire in T1 seconds, and is not set to fire for reliable transports. When the "Completed" state is entered, timer H MUST be set to fire in 64*T1 seconds for all transports.
actions: pass 300-699 response to transport layer for transmission
set Timer G to T1 seconds (unreliable transports only)
set Timer H to 64*T1 seconds (all transports)

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If timer G fires, the response is passed to the transport layer once more for retransmission, and timer G is set to fire in MIN(2*T1, T2) seconds. From then on, when timer G fires, the response is passed to the transport again for transmission, and timer G is reset with a value that doubles, unless that value exceeds T2, in which case it is reset with the value of T2.
actions: pass response to transport layer for retransmission
reset Timer G to MIN(2*T1, T2), doubling each subsequent firing up to T2

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Furthermore, while in the "Completed" state, if a request retransmission is received, the server SHOULD pass the response to the transport for retransmission.
actions: pass response to transport for retransmission

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If an ACK is received while the server transaction is in the "Completed" state, the server transaction MUST transition to the "Confirmed" state. As Timer G is ignored in this state, any retransmissions of the response will cease. When this state is entered, timer I is set to fire in T4 seconds for unreliable transports, and zero seconds for reliable transports.
actions: set Timer I to T4 seconds (unreliable transports) or 0 seconds (reliable transports)

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If timer H fires while in the "Completed" state, it implies that the ACK was never received. In this case, the server transaction MUST transition to the "Terminated" state, and MUST indicate to the TU that a transaction failure has occurred.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Transport Err. Inform TU — arrow from Completed to Terminated shown in Figure 7.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Once timer I fires, the server MUST transition to the "Terminated" state.
